note: Derived RELAYER / SOLVER operational concentration risk from node census + fee-waterfall structural facts. HHI bounded from top1/top5 aggregates (full share vector not exported). Scenarios are arithmetic, not forecasts. Gaps labeled.

risk_classification.read: Top-1 submit choke is operational liveness; solver-as-principal plus submit monopoly sits on the ~8.5 bp excess channel (rent). Neither implies the other is absent.

gasless_vs_near_gas_demand.implication: End users of relayed txs do not need NEAR for gas; gas demand concentrates in operator working balances
gasless_vs_near_gas_demand.intents_second_order: Intents thesis scoreboard is token-claimable bp / capture / attachment — not retail L1 gas demand from Intents users
gasless_vs_near_gas_demand.weakens: Narrative that Intents adoption mechanically lifts broad NEAR gas demand
gasless_vs_near_gas_demand.gap: No split of 8.5 bp excess into destination gas vs solver margin vs pip; no relayer NEAR buy vs recycle series

relayer_hhi.method: Bound from top1_share and top5_share; full 25-vector not in census_usage export

assumptions.lower: top1 fixed; remaining top5 mass split equally across next 4; residual mass split equally across bottom 20
assumptions.upper: top1 fixed; #2 takes entire remainder of top5; bottom residual negligible

single_relayer_downtime_impact.definition: Share of execute_intents lost if top-1 offline with zero failover
single_relayer_downtime_impact.chain_tx_share_impact_note: ≈ intents_tx_share_pct × top1_share; assumes no substitute submitters and Intents txs ≈ execute_intents
single_relayer_downtime_impact.gap: No measured outage / failover latency series in repo

falsifiers_operational_risk_contained.condition: top1_share >= 0.80 or HHI >= 0.65 across multi-day census windows
Documented top-1 outage with Intents settlement drop >= 50% lasting >15-30 minutes without residual absorption
Realized excess over listed rises materially above ~8.5 bp in high top-1 windows
Dominant relayer(s) = dominant solver / inventory economic agents
Captured bp or attachment falls coincident with settlement ops glitch
Retail NEAR gas-demand narrative persists while delegate share stays ~40%+ and Intents remains relayer-submitted

other: Excess bp stable or falling as share disperses

vs_vault_peers.intents_failure_mode: liveness / preferential execution / solver inventory refusal on concentrated submit path
vs_vault_peers.vault_failure_mode: bond-to-TVL economic underwriting break / slash / vault halt (THOR, Maya, Chainflip)
vs_vault_peers.read: Different failure modes — not a smaller version of the same risk. Low validator HHI does not contain Intents relayer risk.

fee_engine_link.silent_dependency: tau / capture / attachment arithmetic assumes continuous concentrated settlement

who_owns_stack.token_claim: three revenue wallets after the above

gaps: Full relayer share vector not exported — HHI bounded only
No labeled outage / failover time series
Relayer to solver entity graph unknown
Chain-wide delegate_share vs Intents execute_intents relayer set are related but not identical populations
proprietary_punch: Settlement is a single-account product: top relayer 83% of execute_intents; top-5 99.9%; N=25 is cosmetic
HHI ~0.69-0.71 vs validator HHI 0.022 — Intents ops ~30x more concentrated than consensus
SRDI ≈ 0.83: top-1 downtime without failover ≈ -83% Intents settlement throughput
Risk is both liveness and rent: principal solvers + submit monopoly sit on the ~8.5 bp excess path
43% gasless means Intents growth does not scale retail NEAR gas demand; operators hold the gas float
Fee-engine numerator (tau / attachment) silently assumes the concentrated submit path stays up and non-extractive
Vault peers fail on bond economics; Intents fails on operator continuity / preferential execution
Operational risk contained is falsified by persistent top-1 >=80%, slow failover, excess-bp spike, or relayer=solver collapse
Score relayer HHI + SRDI + excess bp beside capture metrics; volume share without them overstates fee-engine durability
Effective operator count 1/HHI ≈ 1.4 — underwrite settlement as near-monopoly relay, not decentralized solver mesh
